style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#e2e8f0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=14;spacingRight=16;fontFamily=JetBrains Mono,Noto Sans Mono,DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" value="<span style="font-variant-ligatures:none"><font color="#0891b2">●</font>&nbsp;<b><font color="#0f172a" style="font-size:13px">Request path · data plane</font></b><br><br><div style="line-height:1.6">• A player joins and the server loads their progression.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">1</span> The Minecraft client connects to arffornia.com:25565, an A record on the home IP (DNS-only).<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">2</span> The router forwards to the Velocity LoadBalancer VIP announced by MetalLB.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">3</span> Velocity checks the Mojang session, then forwards the player to lobby = arcane:25565 with modern forwarding.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">4</span> The Arffornia mod calls https://arffornia.com/api (ensure-exists, stages/player): out through the router and back to Envoy.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">5</span> Envoy matches the HTTPRoute arffornia.com and proxies to the website Service.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">6</span> Laravel reads and writes the arffornia database.<br>• Votes: vote site → router :8192 → NuVotifier on Velocity → POST /vote/nuvotifier (view vote-and-reward).</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="390" width="820" x="670" y="1590" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card-control-plane" parent="1" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#e2e8f0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=14;spacingRight=16;fontFamily=JetBrains Mono,Noto Sans Mono,DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" value="<span style="font-variant-ligatures:none"><font color="#7c3aed">●</font>&nbsp;<b><font color="#0f172a" style="font-size:13px">Background · control plane</font></b><br><br><div style="line-height:1.6"><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">A</span> vault-secrets-operator reads kvv2 every 60 s with one Kubernetes role.<br><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">B</span> It writes the Secrets of each VaultSecret (6 in arcane, 5 website, 3 proxy).<br><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">C</span> <span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">D</span> Argo CD pulls infra@HEAD and applies k8s/apps/arffornia/** with prune and selfHeal.<br><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">E</span> Prometheus scrapes the server&#39;s metrics port. <span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">F</span> <span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">G</span> app=minecraft alerts go to the Discord webhook_arffornia.<br><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">H</span> <span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">I</span> The mc-backup sidecar pauses saves over RCON and writes a daily tar.gz to the NAS, kept 14 days.<br><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">J</span> Postgres ships WAL-G backups to in-cluster Garage, kept 90.<br>• MetalLB (L2) announces the LoadBalancer VIPs of Velocity and of Envoy (192.168.1.84).</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="390" width="720" x="1520" y="1590" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card-gaps" parent="1" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#e2e8f0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=14;spacingRight=16;fontFamily=JetBrains Mono,Noto Sans Mono,DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" value="<span style="font-variant-ligatures:none"><font color="#ea580c">●</font>&nbsp;<b><font color="#0f172a" style="font-size:13px">Gaps and risks found in code</font></b><br><br><div style="line-height:1.6"><b><font color="#c2410c">G1</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">No Cloudflare for the site.</font></b> Apex A record proxied = false; only subdomains are proxied.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G2</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">Server writes the website DB.</font></b> JDBC to db arffornia, runs pending_rewards.commands as console commands.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G3</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">API hairpin.</font></b> Server and proxy call the public hostname from inside the cluster.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G4</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">One Vault identity.</font></b> VSO&#39;s single SA is bound to every role; VSO reaches Vault through Cloudflare.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G5</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">No NetworkPolicy.</font></b> RCON, game port (online-mode=false), metrics and BlueMap live open to every pod.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G6</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">Alerting.</font></b> 5 s scrape; CriticalServiceDown watches jobs that are never scraped.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G12</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">Committed credentials.</font></b> Proxy plugin ships its nuvotifier_service client secret in git.</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="390" width="870" x="2270" y="1590" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.span:
How players, browsers and vote sites reach Arffornia, and what each component talks to.
Scope: the Arffornia namespaces on the homelab cluster and the shared services they use · infra@b1e7bdc, Provisioning@235d0b8, Mods@a72e114 · derived from code (kustomize build --enable-helm + app config), 2026-10-29
Out of scope: server nexus (its Application is commented out in k8s/apps/arffornia/server: omitted) · Keycloak, Terraform · mod and config delivery (view content-delivery) · login order (view player-login)
Not verified live (no cluster access): router port forwards and NAT loopback, MetalLB IPs of the Velocity Services (none pinned in code)
v0.1 · source: architecture/arffornia/views/runtime.yaml

span.div:
• A player joins and the server loads their progression.
1 The Minecraft client connects to arffornia.com:25565, an A record on the home IP (DNS-only).
2 The router forwards to the Velocity LoadBalancer VIP announced by MetalLB.
3 Velocity checks the Mojang session, then forwards the player to lobby = arcane:25565 with modern forwarding.
4 The Arffornia mod calls https://arffornia.com/api (ensure-exists, stages/player): out through the router and back to Envoy.
5 Envoy matches the HTTPRoute arffornia.com and proxies to the website Service.
6 Laravel reads and writes the arffornia database.
• Votes: vote site → router :8192 → NuVotifier on Velocity → POST /vote/nuvotifier (view vote-and-reward).

span.div:
A vault-secrets-operator reads kvv2 every 60 s with one Kubernetes role.
B It writes the Secrets of each VaultSecret (6 in arcane, 5 website, 3 proxy).
C D Argo CD pulls infra@HEAD and applies k8s/apps/arffornia/** with prune and selfHeal.
E Prometheus scrapes the server's metrics port. F G app=minecraft alerts go to the Discord webhook_arffornia.
H I The mc-backup sidecar pauses saves over RCON and writes a daily tar.gz to the NAS, kept 14 days.
J Postgres ships WAL-G backups to in-cluster Garage, kept 90.
• MetalLB (L2) announces the LoadBalancer VIPs of Velocity and of Envoy (192.168.1.84).

b.span: Gaps and risks found in code

span.div:
G1 No Cloudflare for the site. Apex A record proxied = false; only subdomains are proxied.
G2 Server writes the website DB. JDBC to db arffornia, runs pending_rewards.commands as console commands.
G3 API hairpin. Server and proxy call the public hostname from inside the cluster.
G4 One Vault identity. VSO's single SA is bound to every role; VSO reaches Vault through Cloudflare.
G5 No NetworkPolicy. RCON, game port (online-mode=false), metrics and BlueMap live open to every pod.
G6 Alerting. 5 s scrape; CriticalServiceDown watches jobs that are never scraped.
G12 Committed credentials. Proxy plugin ships its nuvotifier_service client secret in git.
